items.headline: 'We just refuse to go away': Sarkisian lauds Longhorns after 34-20 victory
items.description: In the wake of a 34-20 victory over Missouri on Saturday, Texas coach Steve Sarkisian lauded his Longhorns, who notched a fourth win over a top-20 opponent, telling reporters, "I believe there's a toughness in our organization that is kind of undeniable."
